nom: MEDITHERAPY Hyaluronic Acid Serum 5.07 fl oz

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one with autoimmune-related chronic dryness and flaking, report the serum absorbs without residue and leaves skin noticeably softer, more moisturized, and less tight.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin used it as a toner and found it extremely hydrating, while another with sensitive combination skin reports it left her skin feeling tight, dry, and slightly irritated after a few days.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin, including some experiencing active flare-ups, report no stinging, redness, or irritation; one reviewer with sensitive combination skin, however, found it left her skin tight, dry, and slightly irritated.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her seventies reports the serum absorbs quickly and leaves her skin feeling nourished, though she does not expect the dramatic 'glow' that younger reviewers describe.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report smoother, firmer-looking skin with fewer visible fine lines after regular use, including one who describes her skin as noticeably less wrinkled; others, including a reviewer with mature skin, say it did not noticeably reduce deeper wrinkles or deliver dramatic anti-aging results.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including several with chronic or autoimmune-related dryness, report a marked increase in hydration, plumpness, and softness that some describe as lasting throughout the day; a few say the effect was underwhelming or that skin felt slightly drier at first before improving with continued use, and one with sensitive combination skin reports persistent tightness and irritation.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or redness-prone skin report the serum calms their skin and causes no added stinging or redness, even during active flare-ups, while one reviewer with sensitive combination skin describes mild irritation developing after a few days.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers report early fading of dark spots or hyperpigmentation with regular use, while another says several weeks of use brought no significant reduction in dark spots.
concerns.blemishes: A couple of reviewers with somewhat sensitive or acne-prone skin report no new breakouts after regular use, and one says it helped keep minor acne scars hydrated rather than dry.

aspects.libelle: Slight tacky feel right after application
Fragrance-free, well tolerated by sensitive skin
Generous bottle size seen as strong value
Pump can be finicky or arrive pre-opened

extraits.texte: Have been using a few days and my sensitive combination skin is starting to feel tight and dry. Little irritated. Doesn't feel moisturized like I had expected. Will keep you posted
It’s light weight and hasn’t irritated my rosacea prone skin even during flare ups putting it on is super easy and my face feels amazing and looks great even with a full on Rosacea flare.

extraits.titre: Awesome! Great choice for Korean 7-skin method
extraits.texte: This is a simple product that does one job and does it really well! It’s a hydrating hyaluronic acid toner serum and I love it. I have dry sensitive rosacea skin and use the K-beauty method of applying multiple very thin layers for this toner serum and it works so well to hydrate and calm my skin. If you have dry skin, I would totally recommend using a hydrating toner, you won’t regret it. This serum dries quick, isn’t sticky and doesn’t pill. I use it under my vit C in the AM and under my retinol in the PM. I love that it’s fragrance free and has a clean and fairly simple ingredient list. The tamper evident box is easily bypassed, so I wish it had a better type of seal, but it does have a clear expiration date. Company transparency checks out too (always research your online skincare purchases!). This isn’t going to give you bam-pow overnight results, but the extra hydration really does make a big difference over time. Plus it’s huge for the price, so you can use it on your neck and decollete too. It’s my go-to hyaluronic acid serum now and I would definitely recommend it.

extraits.titre: Works very well and absorbs quickly
extraits.texte: This is a brand from Korea known for their beauty products. I'm in my 70's, so need all the help I can get to keep my skin somewhat elastic. At my age I'm not going to have a "glowy" skin, so I wasn't expecting that. I use it after I shower in the evening, and it absorbs very quickly into my skin, leaving it feeling nourished. One pump of the foam does my entire face as well as my neck. I don't normally moisturize my face before putting a primer on in the morning, but I have just started doing that with this serum, as I find that it really does make a difference. My primer goes on very smoothly. Probably because the serum absorbs quickly without any greasy feel. A nice large bottle for a reasonable price with a serum that works very well. You can't help but love it!

This stuff is great. I have auto immune and thyroid issues so everything is so dry my hair, my eyes, my skin. To the point where I’m flaking, even though I exfoliate and put lotions on and stuff. But I have several cats and there is hair everywhere so I hate putting much on my face because the hair stick to my face before I know it and I’m fighting cat hair all over my face. What I really love about this it’s almost like water is clear and it goes on and soaks in immediately and doesn’t leave any residue. I’ve been using it for maybe a week and I absolutely love it. My skin is so moisturizing.

I’ve been using the Meditherapy Hyaluronic Acid Serum XXL and overall I’m pleased with the results. The first thing that stood out to me was the size and value- 150ml is incredibly generous for a serum especially at this price point. It feels like it will last a long time which makes it a great deal compared to smaller bottles from other brands. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky residue which I really appreciate. It layers beautifully under moisturizer and makeup, keeping my skin hydrated throughout the day. My skin looks noticeably plumper and more radiant, especially in the mornings. It gives that healthy, glass-skin glow that Korean skincare is known for. The serum has a very subtle, clean scent, nothing overwhelming, which is nice for daily use. I also like that it feels gentle and hasn’t caused any irritation or breakouts, even with my somewhat sensitive skin. Yet while it’s deeply hydrating, it doesn’t quite deliver on the anti-aging or wrinkle care claims as dramatically as I hoped, at least not yet. Still for hydration and overall skin smoothness, it performs beautifully and feels like a smart, budget-friendly addition to my routine.

This simple product has changed my skin drastically! I’m not great at skincare or using anything consistently, but this has been so easy to use. I apply two pumps each morning and night and was just asked my several ladies at church what my secret is because I look 50 years younger (I’m only 42!) and this is the only thing I’ve changed in my skincare routine! My skin has become more supple, less wrinkly, my hyperpigmentation dark spots are fading, and my pores are shrinking. Super effective and great value! Add to cart and buy now!!
